summary: Both the SM6.7 front-end/legalizer bypass (DxilLegalizeSampleOffsetPass.cpp:88-90) and the SM6.7 validator bypass (DxilValidation.cpp:369-372, ValidateResourceOffset) still unconditionally skip the -8..7 constant-offset range check under IsSM67Plus(), confirmed by source reading and by compiling the reporter's exact shader: main-debug (89e2f98e2) accepts int2(12,-14) with exit 0 and the literal offsets embedded in final DXIL, while the identical source at ps_6_6 still emits the range diagnostic. Compiler Explorer's dxc_trunk (Linux Release) reproduces the same defect; dxc_1_6_2112 correctly rejects the profile as SM6.7-unaware. Bisecting stable releases: every release able to target ps_6_7 (v1.7.2207 through v1.9.2607) reproduces, and no earlier stable release can even select the profile, so this is a since-inception gap, not a regression.
title: Sample immediate offset range is not diagnosed or validated in SM 6.7
